paper: Logical Guidance for the Exact Composition of Diffusion Models
statement: On CelebA negation, LOGDIFF has FID 23.61 versus 32.87 for the constant baseline, while AND and OR-CI conformity is comparable to the baseline.
direct_verification_requirements: Author-equivalent CelebA diffusion, composition-classifier, and judge weights
The paper's 5000 samples per task and method with 50 queries of 100 images
clean-fid evaluated independently for each task
Deterministic seeds plus uncertainty across independent generation replicates
Negative control that detects a deliberately corrupted method label or image set
verified_if: A faithful executable campaign reproduces the direction of the NOT FID advantage and the reported AND/OR-CI conformity relationship, with uncertainty and protocol parity fully exposed.
falsified_if: A faithful executable campaign satisfying every stated protocol assumption yields an assumption-satisfying contradiction, such as a statistically supported reversal of the NOT FID ordering.
blocked_if: The author-equivalent model state or faithful metric protocol is unavailable, and neither direct verification nor assumption-satisfying falsification can be executed.
release_audit_scope: The release audit tests executability only. It must never relabel an absent-checkpoint or protocol-mismatch result as empirical verification or falsification.
